title: Weekday surge quickcount & owner map (Oct 2032)
content:
Purpose:
Quick, lightweight weekday surge census to map who owns coverage across regions for small (<=3hr) bursts. Not a formal rota — meant to identify single points of failure and quick reassignments for the next two weeks.

Top-level quick take:
- Estimated potential weekday surge events: 3-6 per region / week (historical thin-signal).
- Current nominal coverage looks OK for NA daytime; EU and APAC have single-owner gaps on Tue/Thu afternoons.
- Short-term mitigations: swap-in weekend-capable backup for APAC Tue window, enable cross-team fallback to SRE on call for high-severity.

Columns: Day | Region | Window (local) | Estimated surge hrs | Primary owner | Backup owner | Coverage gap (yes/no) | Notes | Action item | Est. incremental cost (USD/day)

Summary metrics (rough):
- Total day-slices flagged with coverage gaps: 6/15 (40%).
- Highest-day incremental cost estimate (single slice): Wed EU 210 USD.
- Immediate hires/allocations: 0 (short-term reassign + backup creation).

Assumptions and scope:
- This is a rapid one-off check covering next 2 weeks only. Not a replacement for official oncall rota.
- Est. incremental cost uses simple rate-per-hour (on-call premium + expected burst GPU minutes). Not an invoice.
- "Backup owner" means someone who can respond within 30–60 minutes during the window.

Decisions needed (owners):
- Assign APAC Tue/Thu backups by Fri 2032-10-08 (Priya)
- Approve temporary EU quota bump for Wed heavy eval jobs (Jo -> Infra ticket ENG-4892)
- Enable infra fallback to dedicated pool for APAC short bursts (Samira to open OPS-1321)
